title: Domain Due Diligence Report input
description: Paste the domains you are thinking of buying (or reviewing), then click Start. URLs and email addresses are reduced to the domain. Each valid domain gives one report row. Lines that are not a domain are skipped, saved to INVALID_INPUTS and not charged.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Required. Domain names on any TLD, website URLs or email addresses, one per line, for example example.com, https://www.example.org/page or jane@example.net. Duplicates are checked once. Lines that are not a domain are saved to INVALID_INPUTS in the key-value store and are not charged. Only the first Max domains per run are checked.

lookupRdap.sectionDescription: Leave both options on for a full report. Turning one off makes the run faster but the row will have less detail.
lookupRdap.title: Look up registration details (RDAP)
lookupRdap.description: When on (default), asks the registry's public RDAP server for creation date, age, registrar, expiry and status codes. Requests are throttled to about 3 per second per registry. Turn off for a faster run with no registration details.

fetchLandingPage.title: Inspect landing page (live status, for-sale & price)
fetchLandingPage.description: When on (default), loads the domain's own web page (HTTPS, then HTTP) to record the HTTP status, whether HTTPS works, the page title, marketplace redirects and a visible asking price. Turn off for a faster run with no page details.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Safety cap on how many valid domains are checked in one run. Default 500, allowed 1 to 10000.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many domains are checked at the same time. Default 15, allowed 1 to 30. Registry (RDAP) requests stay throttled whatever this is set to.
